messages:
Priya Rao: noticed a sharp tail-latency cliff on shared-gpu-pool-7 around 21:12 UTC. p95 jumped from ~80ms to ~420ms in <2m. looks correlated with a couple of small-batch requests and one long-seq tenant.
Darius Nguyen: can you paste the perf sample and kernel decision logs? any kernel flips or allocation failures?
Priya Rao: pasting a short sample from the trace:
```log
2026-03-16T21:12:43Z pool=sgp-7 p50=38ms p95=410ms p99=1.1s
tenant=acme-ml seq_len=4096 batch_size=1 queued=8
kernel_selected=fast_attn_v2
kernel_fallback=slow_compat after OOM-warning
kv_cache_hits=12% kv_evictions=high
queued_short_reqs=5 short_seq_len<=128
```
Liam O'Connor: that pattern screams co-batching of a huge sequence with many short requests. batching heuristic probably merged them -> kernel choice flipped -> KV thrash.
Sonya Patel: I replayed a small subset (same timestamps) in staging. If I force isolation (no co-batch across tenants) the tail disappears.
Darius Nguyen: can you run a profiler for the process and capture kernel-switch events + CUDA mem logs? `./tools/profiler --pid 4821 --events kernel_switch,alloc` should do it.
Priya Rao: ran profiler, uploaded snippets: https://redwood.internal/profiles/28345 (flame) and heap map attached in thread.
infra-bot: automated alert: pool-saturation sgp-7 triggered at 2026-03-16T21:12:40Z, scaling attempted -> no spare capacity in zone.
Priya Rao: immediate mitigation: pinned tenant acme-ml to per-tenant lane (dedicated queue) and raised per-tenant concurrency cap to avoid queued small batches piling up. Also toggled batching heuristic: avoid mixing seq_len>1024 with seq_len<=256 for 20m window.
Liam O'Connor: good short-term step. we should also bump KV cache TTL for acme-ml to reduce evictions while it's causing hot KV churn.
Darius Nguyen: opened incident PS-1129 and assigned followups: kernel-selector guardrails, batching heuristic patch, KV policy tweak, and longer-term: per-tenant kernel-stability score to avoid live flips.
Priya Rao: created PS-1129 and draft postmortem stub. Added links to profiler and sample logs.
Sonya Patel: quick note from staging replay: the kernel selector currently trusts batch composition more than per-request seq_len variance. PR suggestion: add per-batch variance threshold and prefer conservative kernel if variance > 0.6.
Liam O'Connor: agree. also add metric: fraction_of_batches_with_mixed_seq_len; alert when >5% for a pool.
Priya Rao: monitoring now. p95 dropped to ~60ms for the pool after the pin and heuristic change.
oncall-bot: incident PS-1129 status updated -> mitigated. Timeline and action items in ticket.
Priya Rao: follow-ups: PRs incoming for batching guard and KV TTL policy. will schedule a longer sync to discuss whether we need a soft partitioning feature for extreme long-seq tenants.
Darius Nguyen: thanks everyone — nice quick triage. we'll keep this on the weekly perf review to decide permanent rollout.
